meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把长记忆文件压缩成省 token 的格式，保留可读备份。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 CLAUDE.md 等记忆文件太长,想省 token 又能留可读备份。
copy.tagline_en: Compress long memory files to save tokens while keeping a readable backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your memory files are long and you want to save tokens without losing readability.

howto.what: Claude 会把 CLAUDE.md、待办清单等记忆文件改写成简短原始的“caveman”风格以减少 token 占用；压缩版覆盖原文件，并在系统数据目录保留一份可读备份。代码、链接等原样保留，只压缩自然语言。
howto.when: 当你输入“/caveman-compress <文件路径>”，或用自然语言要求压缩某个记忆文件时触发。只处理 .md、.txt 等自然语言文件，不碰代码类文件。

say.text: 把 CLAUDE.md 压缩成 caveman 格式，省点 token。
say.note: 压缩后原文件被覆盖，备份存在数据目录。

say.text: 运行 /caveman-compress 处理待办文件 todo.md。
say.note: 命令式触发，可用绝对路径指定文件。

say.text: 将偏好设置文件转成简短风格，保留代码不动。
say.note: 技能只压缩自然语言，代码保持原样。

howto.what_en: Compresses memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos) into terse caveman prose to cut tokens. Overwrites original; readable backup goes to system data dir. Code, URLs, paths, commands, numbers, names stay as-is; only prose is compressed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user types “/caveman-compress <filepath>” or asks to compress a memory file. It only handles natural-language files (.md, .txt, etc.), never code files.

say_en.text: Compress CLAUDE.md into caveman style to save tokens.
say_en.note: Original is overwritten; backup stored in the data dir.
Alternatively, just ask to compress a memory file.

say_en.text: Shorten my preferences file but keep code untouched.
say_en.note: Only prose is rewritten; code blocks stay as-is.
